meta_data.base_class: Cancel a <service> booking based on reservation ID and cancellation reason - refers to various types of reservable services.

user_id.description: The ID of the user who made the <class> reservation.

reservation_id.description: The ID of the <class> reservation to cancel.

reschedule_option.description: Indicates if the user is interested in rescheduling the <class> reservation rather than cancelling outright.

notification_preference.description: The preferred method to notify the user about the <class> reservation cancellation status (e.g., email, SMS).

cancellation_policy_acknowledged.description: Indicates whether the user acknowledges the cancellation policy for the <class> reservation.

priority_cancellation.description: Indicates if the <class> reservation cancellation should be processed with priority.

emergency_cancellation.description: Indicates if the user is canceling due to an emergency and requests special handling.
